theorems.name: Submission.atsm_approxTangent_le_of_flat
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (N M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), μHE[n] (M \ N) = 0 → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z ∈ N, dist z x < ρ → ∃ t ∈ T, ‖z - x - t‖ ≤ ε * ‖z - x‖) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → Q ≤ T
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
